Primary Sketchfab API verified downloadable with license `by` on 22 October 2026; see `tesla-roadster-source.json`.

Downloaded from the licensed [carros redistribution](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros) ([source manifest](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros/blob/main/cars.json), [provenance](https://github.com/pedrosoandre/carros/blob/main/LICENSE-3D-MODELS.md)). That redistribution applies weld, simplification, prune, and Meshopt compression. Game adaptations: normalization/orientation, wheel-only geometry rebased to centered animation pivots, and user-selectable body paint/wheel substitutions. No new car model was generated. Brand names identify the model subject and imply no endorsement.
